title: As conflict in the Middle East intensifies, India’s relationship with Israel deepens
summary_full: An Amnesty International report reveals that the country is now a key part of Israel’s weapons supply chain. Why is it that India has formed an even closer bond with a country that has faced mounting international isolation and backlash over a military campaign in Gaza that has left the territory in ruins and killed more than 70,000 Palestinians, – many of whom were children?
